name: The Shift — Adaptive Queue Reel
tagline: One session mixing MCQ, mini-games, and a boss fight — zero manual setup.
audience: PTCB students · pharmacy educators · social media · product demos
estimatedSecNote: Actual duration is driven by ElevenLabs per-line synthesis in DemoForge

steps.narration: The Shift Queue is an adaptive study session — it reads your mastery, picks the right mode at the right moment, and runs the whole thing for you.
Eight game modes staged in one run. Blueprints, Drop, Minefield, Field Work, Boss fights — mixed automatically.
Deploy — and the first mission is straight recall. Quick hit, baseline check.
Next slot switches to Blueprints — a full procedure builder, inline, no loading a separate screen.
The Drop — same queue, different mechanic. React before the term fades.
Boss Fight — the full phased encounter. Radar, HP bars, intercept or clear under pressure.
The Minefield drops in — breach the grid, defuse one cell at a time.
Field Work closes the run — classified dossier, real decision, tribunal ruling. Eight modes, one session, zero setup. That's why the Queue works.
